_readme: Case studies, hand-edited. Rendered by js/cases.js (CC.renderCases) on the homepage proof rail and on each leg's 'Selected work' section. Add a case by appending an object to 'cases'. Fields render in this order and ONLY when present (leave a field out, or empty, and nothing renders for it; never add placeholder text): id (required, lowercase-hyphenated; the case's anchor is #case-<id>), leg (required: 'studio' | 'network' | 'consultancy'), client (required, spelled exactly as the client spells it), occasion (what the job was for), date (YYYY-MM-DD), summary (one line for the compact rail card; defaults to the assignment), assignment (what we were asked to do), crew (list of {name, role}), captured (list of strings: what was captured or made on the day), deliverables (list of strings), media (list of {type: 'image'|'video', src: path under the site root or a full URL, alt (required for images), caption, poster (video only), embed (optional iframe URL, e.g. a YouTube embed, instead of src)}), turnaround (only if it was actually stated), testimonial ({quote, name, role, approved: true}; renders only when approved is true and the client signed off). Do not add clients, results, numbers, or quotes that are not real and approved.

cases.summary: Documentary and behind-the-scenes coverage of a fashion presentation.
